text: dsh-inject-head 是 DSH 提示词插件，会注册排序靠前的 operator:head 区段，并提供 inject_head 变量，把自定义文本放到系统提示词开头。文本可来自 DSH_INJECT_HEAD_TEXT、DSH_INJECT_HEAD_FILE 指定的 UTF-8 文件，或 DSH_HOME 下的 inject-head.md；文件变更后会在后续组装时重新读取。普通 preset 自动使用区段，complete preset 可在 persona 前缀引用变量。适合需要统一提示词前置说明的 DSH 用户。代码未声明 API key 或运行时外部服务。

dsh-inject-head puts custom text at the start of DSH prompts through an early section and an inject_head variable. Text comes from environment variables or a local file, reread after changes. Complete presets can reference the variable. No API key or runtime external service is declared.
想给每轮 DSH 系统提示词最前面加一段固定说明。
能不能从文件读取自定义提示词前缀，并在文件更新后自动采用？
Add a reusable instruction before the rest of each DSH system prompt.
dsh-inject-head 的功能「提示词前置文本」：把配置的文本注册为排序靠前的系统提示词区段，并作为 inject_head 变量提供给完整 preset。文本可通过环境变量或文件提供；文件变化后在下一次组装时重新读取。

dsh-inject-head README · dsh-inject-head：Inject a fixed block of text at the **very top** of every DeepSeek Harness system prompt — including presets that normally discard outside contributions.

Zero dependencies. One file to edit. Takes effect on the next turn, no restart.

```
your text                                  ← line 1, this plugin
You are an AI agent that helps the user…   ← harness identity
…deployment persona, tools, policies…
```

---

dsh-inject-head README · Why this needs two mechanisms：DSH assembles a prompt by sorting sections ascending on `(order, name)` and joining the non-empty ones with blank lines. A section at order `-5000` therefore lands above `harness:identity` (`-1000`) and the deployment persona (`0`):

| Section | Order |
|---|---|
| `operator:head` ← **this plugin** | `-5000` |
| `harness:identity` | `-1000` |
| `deployment:persona-prefix` | `0` |
| tools / policies | `1000 … 9900` |
| `deployment:persona-suffix` | `10200` |

dsh-inject-head README · Why this needs two mechanisms：But a preset declared `complete: true` (for example `minimal`) runs `sections: [ownPersona]` at the end of assembly and throws every other section away. No section can reach it — that is host behaviour, not a limitation of this plugin.

So the plugin registers **two** things from the same text source:

1. the global section `operator:head` at order `-5000`, with `interpolate: false` so braces and `{{…}}` in your own words can never break an assembly;
2. the prompt variable `inject_head`.

dsh-inject-head README · Why this needs two mechanisms：Section-based presets get the text for free. For a `complete: true` preset, add one line to that preset's persona prefix:

```yaml
prefix: >-
  {{inject_head}}

You are a helpful software engineer assistant.

The same file still drives the text. Nothing else about the preset changes.
dsh-inject-head README · Install：Link the package into the profile's `node_modules`, then restart the harness once. Editing the text afterwards never needs a restart.

dsh-inject-head README · Configure：One text source, four levels, highest priority first:

| Priority | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_TEXT` | inline; trimmed |
| 2 | `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_FILE` | path to a UTF-8 file; trimmed |
| 3 | `$DSH_HOME/inject-head.md` | default path (`~/.dsh/inject-head.md`) |
| 4 | `DEFAULT_TEXT` in `index.mjs` | `''` — inject nothing |

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh
printf 'Answer in English. Prefer short answers.\n' > ~/.dsh/inject-head.md
```

dsh-inject-head README · Configure：- **edit** the file → next assembly picks it up (cached on `mtime`)
- **empty** the file → injection silently stops
- **delete** the file → nothing is injected

Use the environment variables when you want the text to travel with the shell rather than with the home directory — useful for per-project overrides.

dsh-inject-head README · Verify：Ask the harness to dump the composed prompt, or check the first line of any session:

```bash
dsh --profile "$DSH_PROFILE" --dump-config
```

The plugin row appears as `inject-head` with `name` pointing at `index.mjs`. To check the assembled prompt instead, ask your agent *"what is the first line of your system prompt?"* — it should be your text verbatim.

Run the plugin's own tests:

```bash
npm test    # 9/9 passed
```

dsh-inject-head README · Limits：- **`complete: true` presets need the one-line persona edit.** The plugin cannot inject a section into them; only the variable route works.
- **Don't edit a preset persona that another plugin asserts on.** Some plugins validate a preset's persona by exact string equality and silently disable themselves when it changes. Adding `{{inject_head}}` to such a preset will trip that check — use a different preset, or leave that one uncovered.
- **The text enters session history.** It is part of the system prompt, so it shows up in exported or shared sessions. Never put secrets in it.
- **It costs tokens every turn.** A short line is negligible; a paragraph is not.

dsh-inject-head README · 中文说明：在每份系统提示词的最上方注入一段固定文本。

- 唯一真源是 `~/.dsh/inject-head.md`，改完下一轮即生效，不用重启
- 清空文件即关闭注入，删除文件则什么都不注入
- 也可用 `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_TEXT`（直接给文本）或 `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_FILE`（指定文件）覆盖

覆盖范围：普通 preset（standard / ptc / cordis 这类按 section 组装的）自动生效；声明了 `complete: true` 的 preset（如 `minimal`）在组装末尾会丢弃所有其它 section，需要你在它的 persona 前缀里加一行 `{{inject_head}}`，文本仍由同一个文件驱动。

已知边界：若某个 preset 的 persona 被其它插件按精确字符串校验，改它会让那个插件静默失效 —— 这种情况请换一个 preset，或让它保持不覆盖。注入内容会进入会话历史，导出或分享会话时可见，不要放密钥。
